content.short: Atomic Wallet is a self custody wallet for Toncoin and many other assets across mobile and desktop apps.
content.description: Atomic Wallet is a self custody crypto wallet that supports Toncoin alongside a broad list of digital assets on desktop and mobile. Its official wallet pages emphasize local private key control, portfolio management, asset storage, exchange features, and buying options for supported coins. Within the TON app set, Atomic Wallet fits as a multichain wallet for users who want to hold and manage TON in the same interface they use for other assets, rather than relying on a TON only wallet or an exchange based account.
content.meta: Atomic Wallet gives users a self custody way to store, manage, and access Toncoin alongside many other supported crypto assets.
